#!/bin/bash

# Create a temporary file to store files with their md5sums
md5sum *.jpg > /tmp/photo_hashes.txt

declare -A dup_files

        seen[$hash]=1
    else
        dup_files[$filepath]=1
    fi

# Get all remaining jpg files
